about: Checks of ReflexGrid against the Microsoft Excel installed on a Mac (scripts/excel_vba_oracle_mac.py, scripts/excel_check_mac.py). Each check records the Excel version, the macOS version, the ReflexGrid commit and the date it ran, how many cases Excel and ReflexGrid answered alike, and every difference.

vba-language.title: VBA language and library: each expression and function evaluated by Excel's VBA and by ReflexGrid's

not_compared.why: Excel for Mac names the type of an array V() where Excel for Windows says Variant(); ReflexGrid follows Windows

not_run.why: they use what only Excel for Windows has (CDec, Scripting.Dictionary, non-ASCII source); their expected answers follow Windows

vba-objects.title: Excel object model: each scenario run as a macro by Excel and by ReflexGrid, comparing what it answers and the cells it leaves

userforms.title: UserForms ReflexGrid wrote, loaded by Excel, which describes each form and control (type, position, size, caption, value, lists, fonts…) as ReflexGrid does

userform-events.title: The events a form's code fires, and their order, in Excel and in ReflexGrid

userform-designer.title: Forms made and changed with ReflexGrid's form designer, loaded and described by Excel

files.title: Workbooks ReflexGrid wrote: opened by Excel, their values, formulas and displayed text read there, saved by Excel, and Excel's files recalculated by ReflexGrid to Excel's results

not_compared.why: they use functions this Excel lacks (IFS, XLOOKUP, SEQUENCE, TEXTJOIN, LET)
